# `dashboard/views/producers.ts`

## Overview

Provides view-layer rendering functions and supporting utilities for the producers dashboard. This module exposes HTML string producers for individual producer cards and the full producers page, along with internal helpers for formatting durations, timestamps, currency values, and computing health status from run history.

---

## Exported Functions

### `producerCardPartial`

```ts
import { producerCardPartial } from '...'
```

Renders a single producer card with health status, schedule info, last run stats, and recent run history table.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `producer` | `ProducerData` | The producer data to render |

**Returns:** `string` — An HTML string representing the producer card.

---

### `producersPage`

```ts
import { producersPage } from '...'
```

Full producers dashboard page listing all producers with their health status, config, and run history.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `data` | `ProducersPageData` | Page-level data containing all producers |
| `user` | `SessionUser` | The currently authenticated session user |

**Returns:** `string` — An HTML string representing the complete producers dashboard page.

## Types & Interfaces

### `ProducerRun`

Represents a single execution record for a producer.

```ts
interface ProducerRun {
  id: number;
  producer: string;
  repo: string | null;
  tasksCreated: number | null;
  duplicatesSkipped: number | null;
  errors: unknown;
  costUsd: string | null;
  durationMs: number | null;
  createdAt: Date | null;
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `id` | `number` | Unique identifier for the run |
| `producer` | `string` | Name of the producer that executed |
| `repo` | `string \| null` | Repository associated with the run, if any |
| `tasksCreated` | `number \| null` | Number of tasks created during the run |
| `duplicatesSkipped` | `number \| null` | Number of duplicate tasks skipped |
| `errors` | `unknown` | Error data from the run, if any |
| `costUsd` | `string \| null` | Estimated cost of the run in USD |
| `durationMs` | `number \| null` | Total run duration in milliseconds |
| `createdAt` | `Date \| null` | Timestamp when the run was created |

---

### `ProducerData`

Represents a single producer and its associated configuration and run history.

```ts
interface ProducerData {
  name: string;
  runs: ProducerRun[];
  schedule: string | null;
  enabledRepos: string[];
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `name` | `string` | The name of the producer |
| `runs` | `ProducerRun[]` | List of recent runs for this producer |
| `schedule` | `string \| null` | Cron or schedule expression for the producer, if configured |
| `enabledRepos` | `string[]` | List of repositories this producer is enabled for |

---

### `ProducersPageData`

Top-level data container passed to the producers page view.

```ts
interface ProducersPageData {
  producers: ProducerData[];
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `producers` | `ProducerData[]` | All producers to display on the dashboard page |
